decisions.decision: Added .chat-message-wrapper block div around .chat-message flex row + .chat-replies
decisions.rationale: Replies were flex children inside .chat-message (display:flex), causing horizontal layout. Moving .chat-replies outside the flex container into a block wrapper fixes vertical stacking.

decisions.decision: Comments data uses flat format with parent_id, not pre-nested replies
decisions.rationale: buildCommentTree() in comments.js expects flat array and builds tree itself via parent_id field

decisions.decision: Admin mode requires BOTH localStorage sde-admin-mode=true AND sessionStorage sde-admin-authenticated=true
decisions.rationale: Password-protected admin via admin-utils.js — just setting localStorage alone won't unlock features
